test: frontend/__tests__/sidebar.test.tsx::Sidebar > renders all 8 nav items for an admin with their accessible labels
current_behavior: Rendered <AuthProvider> without mocking global fetch, then asserted each of the 8 nav links with findByRole.
proposed_change: Mock globalThis.fetch in renderSidebar the way fees-chart.test.tsx already does, answering /auth/memberships with a membership matching the seeded tenant context, and seed writeTenantContext('t'). Assertions, cases and timeouts unchanged.
justification: The spec depended on ambient network state. AuthProvider.syncMemberships issues a real request to NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL on mount; a dev backend listening on :4000 answers 401, apiRequest retries via /auth/refresh which also 401s, and the resulting onAuthFailure callback runs clearStoredTokens + setStatus("anonymous") mid-test. The probe then reads "anonymous:-" and the role-gated /schedules and /users links are never rendered. Measured 2 failures in 4 consecutive full-suite runs before the change (identical rate with the new fees-chart cases excluded, so unrelated to that work) and 0 in 6 runs after, with the backend up in both cases.
risk: The test no longer incidentally exercises the live-401 sign-out path, which it never asserted on and which api.test.ts and the auth-provider specs cover directly. Nav coverage is unchanged — the same 8 links are still asserted.
agent_action: Applied after explicit user approval. Added a fetch mock and tenant-context seed in renderSidebar plus writeTenantContext(null) cleanup in afterEach; no assertion, case or timeout was altered. Verified 6/6 green full-suite runs with a backend live on :4000. Note: an earlier entry attributed the flake to bootstrapSession latency — the real trigger is the syncMemberships 401 chain described above.
